notes:
New in 0.1.2.2:
- Water keeps its volume: before, a dam break lost about a quarter of its water after 15 seconds (squeezed together); now it keeps 99%. Turn the fix off and on with D to compare.
- No more lines or speckles inside the water: it now reads as one solid body with a faint white outline on the surface. Spray and droplets still show as single particles.
- The volume value in the stats bar shows how much water is kept (100% = none lost).

From 0.1.2.1:
- Settings window (Esc), widescreen for any screen (16:9, 21:9, 32:9), water always runs at real speed.

From 0.1.2:
- Water about 5x faster, identical results on every PC; brush tools (Ctrl removes, wheel size, Square/Circle).

Known limits:
- All graphics are placeholders.
- The volume fix costs a little speed; the faster pressure solver is still to come in 1.2.
